fullItinerary:
09:00 AM - Meeting Point & Introduction
Meet your local jungle guide in Bukit Lawang. Receive a short introduction, safety briefing and information about the rainforest before starting your adventure.
09:30 AM - Start Jungle Trekking
Enter the tropical rainforest of Gunung Leuser National Park. Explore beautiful jungle trails while looking for wild Sumatran orangutans, Thomas leaf monkeys, gibbons, macaques and tropical birds.
11:00 AM - Wildlife Observation
Enjoy opportunities to observe wild animals in their natural environment. Your guide will share interesting information about orangutan behaviour, rainforest plants and local wildlife.
12:30 PM - Jungle Lunch Break
Take a relaxing break and enjoy a freshly prepared local lunch with tropical fruits surrounded by the beautiful rainforest.
01:30 PM - Continue Exploring the Rainforest
Continue your jungle adventure and discover more of the incredible biodiversity of Sumatra. Enjoy the peaceful atmosphere and learn about the importance of rainforest conservation.
03:00 PM - Return Journey
Start trekking back towards Bukit Lawang. Depending on weather and river conditions, you can also enjoy an optional traditional river tubing experience.
04:00 PM - End of the Adventure
Arrive back in Bukit Lawang with unforgettable memories of your Sumatran jungle experience.
included: Applicable national park and local fees (subject to confirmation)
excluded: Transport to and from Bukit Lawang
important: River tubing is optional, costs extra, and depends on weather and river conditions.
National park and local fee inclusion is subject to confirmation.

fullItinerary:
DAY 1 - INTO THE RAINFOREST
09:00 AM - Meeting Point & Preparation
Meet your local jungle guide in Bukit Lawang. Before starting the adventure, your guide will explain the trekking route, safety guidelines, and responsible wildlife-watching practices.
09:30 AM - Start Jungle Trekking
Enter Gunung Leuser National Park and begin exploring the tropical rainforest. During the trek, you may have the opportunity to see:
- Wild Sumatran orangutans
- Thomas leaf monkeys
- Long-tailed macaques
- Gibbons
- Hornbills and other tropical birds
- Beautiful rainforest plants and trees
Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed, as animals live freely in their natural habitat.
12:30 PM - Lunch in the Jungle
Enjoy a freshly prepared lunch surrounded by the beautiful sounds of the rainforest.
01:30 PM - Continue Exploring
Continue trekking deeper into the rainforest while discovering more wildlife, tropical plants, and the fascinating ecosystem of Gunung Leuser National Park.
04:00 PM - Arrive at Jungle Campsite
Arrive at your riverside jungle campsite. Relax, enjoy the natural surroundings, and spend time with your guide.
07:00 PM - Dinner & Overnight Stay
Enjoy dinner at the campsite and experience a peaceful night in the rainforest, surrounded by the sounds of nature.
DAY 2 - RAINFOREST ADVENTURE & RIVER RETURN
07:00 AM - Breakfast in the Jungle
Wake up to the sounds of the rainforest and enjoy breakfast at the campsite.
08:00 AM - Morning Jungle Exploration
Continue exploring the rainforest with your guide. Look for more wildlife, enjoy the fresh jungle atmosphere, and discover the incredible biodiversity of Sumatra.
11:00 AM - Return Towards the River
Begin trekking back towards the river while enjoying the last moments of your rainforest adventure.
12:00 PM - Traditional Jungle River Tubing
Enjoy an exciting traditional river tubing experience back to Bukit Lawang, surrounded by beautiful rainforest scenery.
01:00 PM - Arrive in Bukit Lawang
Your two-day jungle adventure comes to an end. Return to your accommodation with unforgettable memories of Sumatra.
included: Traditional river tubing back to Bukit Lawang
important: Suitable for adventurous beginners with reasonable fitness.
The trekking route and wildlife encounters depend on weather, trail conditions and animal movements.
Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed. Observe animals from a safe distance without feeding, touching, chasing or disturbing them.
